analyst.summary: IEX's FY26 fundamentals remain strong -- revenue +13.6% to Rs 747cr, PAT +14.9% to Rs 493cr, record 141.1 BU volume (+17%), 36% ROE, debt-free balance sheet -- and Q1 FY27 volumes grew a further 15.9% YoY with no confirmed market-share loss yet (IEX still ~84-85% of exchange volume). The existential risk, CERC-mandated market coupling, has slipped twice: the Jan-2026 round-robin go-live was missed, APTEL found the specific rules 'not yet framed' in Feb-2026, and CERC's Apr-2026 redesign (single Grid-India operator) only closed for comment 16-May-2026 with implementation procedures still ~6 months from a notification that hasn't happened -- realistic go-live is FY28 at the earliest. Fee-per-unit compression is already visible pre-coupling (revenue growing slower than volume) as IEX defends share against PXIL/HPX, and other income is volatile quarter to quarter. At 22.6x trailing earnings, down ~60-65% from the 2024 peak multiple, the stock sits at or below several independently published bear-to-base fair-value estimates -- a meaningfully bearish scenario already looks priced in, but the risk itself is not resolved. Hold, flagged for Principal visibility given the size of the position and the still-open regulatory endgame.
